16	| Daisy Chain Interface | Differential | Isolated cable / Transformer coupling |

The system boundary document says:
`| LV to HV (Comm) | CB / BMM | Capacitor/Transformer | 1000V DC | Isolated Daisy Chain |`

The module boundary document says:
`| P1.1 | Bi-dir | AC-I/O | Differential | COMHP / COMHN | Isolated differential daisy chain (High side connection to stack). |`
`| P1.2 | Bi-dir | AC-I/O | Differential | COMLP / COMLN | Isolated differential daisy chain (Low side connection for ring). |`

And the Eval board schematic part 2 shows "Transformer isolation options (COML)" and "Transformer isolation options (COMH)" as well as "Capacitor + choke isolation option".

For a 1000V isolation rating (as per system doc), Transformers are usually safer and better for EMI. I'll stick with the transformer option.

I need to confirm the values of the components in the COM isolation circuit from the crops of Part 2.
